items.title: 4.3.1 Combining Stacks and Queues to Evaluate Expressions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of combining stacks and queues (PDF 118).

blocks.text: Stacks aur queues mil kar expressions, khaas taur par pecheeda, nikalne mein madad dete hain: yeh amal ki tarteeb sambhalte, qausain dekhte aur durust jawab yaqeeni banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Infix se postfix banane mein stack kya rakh sakta aur queue kya?
blocks.explanation: Stack operators aur qausain rakhta hai; output tokens ki queue ho sakti hai, jo postfix nikalte waqt aage se parhi jaye. Yeh jora aam ilm hai; kitab koi hal shuda misal nahi deti.

items: Stacks aur queues mil kar expressions mein operators ki tarteeb aur qausain sambhalte hain.
